status: partly observed: on Claude Code 2.1.310 (2026-10-28) a typed /westack loaded the router and the implicit request 'Use westack to list the installed skills' did not; the other cases are not-run. Wave 1 (eval, verify, debug, review built) changed the expected answers of the cases marked 'expectation updated'; those were not re-run
note: westack 1.0 makes the router explicit-only (disable-model-invocation: true), so only a typed /westack or the host picker activates it; naming westack in prose does not on a host that honours the flag. Routing inside the router (which sub-skill owns a request) is evaluated by the planned confusion matrix, not here. Earlier westack (then called estack) 0.3 cases (an automatic trigger) are retired with that change.
